# Look: Neo-brutalist

> Lede 0.8.0's docs for Look: Neo-brutalist, installed with it. Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/look-brutal.md

Raw structure, shown on purpose: thick outlines, hard offset shadows, flat loud fills and no curves. A look over Lede's components: import `styles/lede/looks/brutal.css` after Lede's index.css, then set `<ThemeProvider look="brutal">` (or `data-look="brutal"` on a theme root). High contrast keeps Lede's -hc palette, and an accent picked on a provider still replaces the look's.

Experimental: its props can change in a minor release, which the CHANGELOG names. An item is experimental for the release that adds it, and stable once a release ships it unchanged.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @lede/look-brutal
```

The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md) and [`theme-provider`](theme-provider.md), and the npm packages `@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk@5.3.0`. The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.8.0/look-brutal.json.
